spans.text: Saestona nagara-nagara anggota ampon ajanji areng-sareng Perserikatan Bangsa- Bangsa kaangguy matenggi kamajuwan, ajina ban hormatepon sadajana oreng dha' hak-hak asasi manossa ban kebebasan dhasar.

entries.description: sanget penting kaangguy nglakone onggu-onggu janji kasebbut
entries.subject: sanget penting

spans.text: Saestona pemahaman se padha parkara hak-hak ban kebebasan-kebebasan kasebbut sanget penting kaangguy nglakone onggu-onggu janji kasebbut, melaepon:

Kaangguy patogan omom se anyata'agi hasel kaanguy sadajana oreng ban sadajana nagara klaban tojjuwan sopaja sabban oreng sareng sabban perserekatadan e dhalem masyarakat, klaban emot terros dha' pernyataan gapaneka badhi ajuangngagi ngangguy cara ngajari sareng adhidhik nyopre matenggi rasa hormat dha' hak-hak ban kabebasan-kabebasan kasebbut klaban jalan se maju, nasional juga internasional, nyoppre makowat pengakoan ban penghormadan se universal ban efektif se ejalannagi sareng bangsa-bangsa dhari Nagara-Nagara Anggota ka'dhinto dibhi', juga sareng bangsa-bangsa dhari wilayah-wilayah se ebabana kabasaannepon hukum nagara ka'dhinto.

entries.subject: lahir mardika
entries.object: sarenge drajat klaban hak-hak se dha-padha

spans.text: Sadajana oreng lahir mardika e sarenge drajat klaban hak-hak se dha-padha.

entries.task_id: ta' kengeng|e|badhi budhak otaba epaksa daddi abdi
entries.description: ta' kengeng e badhi budhak otaba epaksa daddi abdi
entries.subject: ta' kengeng
entries.object: badhi budhak otaba epaksa daddi abdi

spans.text: Pasera bisaos ta' kengeng e badhi budhak otaba epaksa daddi abdi, perbudhakan sareng adagang budhak macam panapa bisaos kodu elarang.

Tadha' oreng se kengeng e anggep sala alakone tindak pidana karna kalakoan otaba kealpaan se benni pelanggaran hokom mitorot undang-undang nasional otaba internasional bakto kalakoan gapaneka ejalani.

Hak gapaneka ta' kengeng e angguy manabi parkaraepon saongguna ta' karna kejahatan-kejahatan se badha hubunganna sareng politik otaba dhari kalakoan-kalakoan se alaban tojjuan-tojjuan ban prinsip-prinsip Parsarekatan Bangsa-Bangsa.

entries.description: se padha e dalem naongan hukum
entries.subject: se padha

spans.text: Sadajana oreng gaduwan hak se padha e dalem naongan hukum, ta' epabida.

entries.task_id: a lenggi|e|settong kenengan dhalem bates-bates sabban nagara
entries.description: a lenggi e settong kenengan dhalem bates-bates sabban nagara
entries.subject: a lenggi
entries.object: settong kenengan dhalem bates-bates sabban nagara

spans.text: Saban oreng agadhuwi hak sareng kabebasan le-ngalle otaba a lenggi e settong kenengan dhalem bates-bates sabban nagara.
Sabban oreng agadhuwi hak nyare klaban anekmati e negara-negara laen, naongan dhari etabeng parkara.

entries.description: kawarganegaraanna otaba e tolak hak agante kewarganegaraan
entries.subject: kawarganegaraanna otaba

spans.text: Tadha oreng kengeng epaksa ngocol kawarganegaraanna otaba e tolak hak agante kewarganegaraan.
Oreng lake' ban bine se ampon cokop omor, agudhuwi hak akabin ban abangon kaluarga, sareng ta' olle ebatesi klaban alasan ras, kawarganegaraan otaba agama.

entries.task_id: omom bi'dibi'|kaangguy|anyata'agi agamana otaba kayakenna sae dhalem ngajari
entries.description: omom bi'dibi' kaangguy anyata'agi agamana otaba kayakenna sae dhalem ngajari
entries.subject: omom bi'dibi'
entries.object: anyata'agi agamana otaba kayakenna sae dhalem ngajari

spans.text: Sabban oreng agadhuwi hak kabebasan pamekkeran, nurani ban agama, dhalem hak gapaneka masok kabebasan agante agamana otaba keyakenna, sareng kabebasan alakone agamana otaba kayakenna bi'dibi'an otaba a reng-sareng oreng laen secara omom bi'dibi' kaangguy anyata'agi agamana otaba kayakenna sae dhalem ngajari, alakone ibadah secara khusu'.
